privacy_boundaries: This public repository may consume only public-safe reviewed inputs.
Never add private venture plans, private relationships, customer or employer confidential information, credentials, or unannounced concepts.
Every material public claim requires source context and must stay within the Exafuse, inspection, and engineering-decision boundaries.
A local build is not publication; pushing, deployment, indexing, profile edits, and public release require exact human authorization.
